title: TempArtifactInventoryRequest
description: P089 MCP tool temp_artifacts.inventory.preview request schema fixture.

run_id.description: Run ID for which to preview inventory. Mutually exclusive with workspace_context.

workspace_context.description: Workspace context for inventory. Mutually exclusive with run_id.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. No clamping; values outside 0-500 are rejected.

timeout_ms.description: Total request deadline in milliseconds, including queue wait.

include_dry_run.description: When false, dry_run and row dry_run_recommendation are null.

test_root_override.description: Diagnostic test root override. Absolute path only; accepted only under authorized diagnostic-test-root mode.
